1. Upon receipt of requisite approvals, Company on 05.01.2022, allotted 13,50,00,000 Warrants on preferential basis to a Promoter Group Entity. Said Warrant are convertible into, or exchangeable for, 1 fully paid-up equity share having face value of Rs. 1/- each, within a period of 18 months from date of allotment. Owing to pending litigations and Orders of Honble Debt Recovery Tribunal (DRT), Warrant holder is constraint to seek conversion of warrants into shares and accordingly warrants could not be converted into equity shares. Requisite application was filed with SEBI, seeking exemption. SEBI vide its communication dated 24-08-2023, has inter alia advised Company that Company may seek exemption from SEBI post final order of DRT and to abide by directions of the DRT.
2. Upon receipt of requisite approvals, Company on 07.11.2024, allotted 13,33,33,333 Warrants on preferential basis to a three FPIs (NonPromoter). The aforesaid FPIs expressed their unwillingness to exercise the conversion option of the outstanding Warrants, which was due on or before May 7, 2026, accordingly, the said warrants have lapsed upon expiry of the exercise period, i.e., with effect from May 8, 2026. Consequently,the upfront subscription amount (referred to as Warrant Subscription Price), being 25% of the Warrant Issue Price (i.e., Rs. 3.75/- per Warrant), aggregating to Rs. 49,99,99,999/-, received by the Company at the time of allotment of convertible Warrants stands forfeited.
3. Primat Infrapower and Multiventures Private Limited is currently undergoing Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). Further, companies forming part of the Promoter Group that are under liquidation or CIRP proceedings have not been considered herein.
4. The Company allotted 3,00,00,000 equity shares on June 30, 2026 to one FPI pursuant to the conversion of warrants out of the 14,00,00,000 fully convertible warrants issued on June 25, 2026 to three FPIs. However, the corporate action for credit of the aforesaid equity shares to the allottee's demat account shall be undertaken upon receipt of the requisite listing approvals from the Stock Exchanges. This shareholding pattern includes the details of the aforesaid allotment of equity shares, including lock-in and demat account details.
